attributes.name: Haunted Doll
attributes.powers:
When you acquire this card, you may recharge a random card from your discard pile.

At the start of a turn, display this card. While displayed, you may add 2 and the Magic trait to your checks that invoke the Divine or Undead trait. At the end of the turn, discard this card; you may succeed at an Arcane 7 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
